references.text: Moses reminds the people that they were slaves in Egypt and that the Lord brought them out with a strong hand
The Lord presents himself as the one who brought Israel out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery
The Lord's promise to free Israel from slavery in Egypt with an outstretched arm and mighty acts of judgment
The Lord brought Israel out of Egypt with a strong hand and an outstretched arm
The Lord led Israel out of the house of slavery with a strong hand and rescued them from Pharaoh's power
Remembrance of slavery in Egypt is used as a reason to treat slaves well
Israel's slavery in Egypt is given as the basis for keeping the Passover commandment
Remembrance of slavery in Egypt as a reason to show justice toward the weak
Confession that the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt with a strong hand and an outstretched arm
Praise of the Lord who brought Israel out of Egypt with a strong hand and an outstretched arm
The prophet reminds us that the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm
